method: Refreshed 2026-11-09 (weekly review): past events removed; rows kept from the 2026-10-18 hand collection (DefiLlama, app.tokenomics.com, Tokenomist, CryptoTicker, RootData, KuCoin/Bittime/Coingabbar/CryptoBriefing) and updated/added from pages opened on 2026-11-09: TechFlow weekly unlock digest (credits Tokenomist, % of circulating), mrnasdog.com monthly unlock pages Nov-2026/Dec-2026/Jan-2027 (prices of 08.11; table % is of supply), ChainCatcher Q4-2026 outlook, KuCoin/CryptoRank Q4 summary. Threshold: >=1% of circulating supply or >=$10M. Each row has its source URL.

fields.pct_circ: unlock as % of circulating supply at time of reporting; see pct_basis - tokenomics.com %-of-mcap is unlock/circulating at current price and uses that site's circulating figure, so it can differ from DefiLlama float % for the same event
fields.usd_m: USD value in $M as stated by the source (price snapshot ~Oct 17-18 2026), null if not stated
fields.projected: true = date/size taken from a documented recurring cadence rather than an itemised row
fields.confidence: high = detail page with breakdown agrees with other sources; medium = one itemised source; low = trackers disagree materially or only a headline %
fields.perp_binance_bybit: verified = listing headline found this session; likely = known Binance/Bybit perp as of mid-2026 (not re-checked); unknown = not checked/unclear

excluded_checked.OP: tokenomics.com: vesting ended 2026-04-30, no events in window
excluded_checked.JTO: DefiLlama: no cliffs; only ~0.49%-of-float weekly unlocks (https://defillama.com/unlocks/jito)
excluded_checked.PLUME: DefiLlama: no upcoming cliffs, weekly linear only (https://defillama.com/unlocks/plume-mainnet)
excluded_checked.TIA: ~0.6% (Bittime) and no USD figure; below threshold
excluded_checked.linear_only: WLD, TRUMP, SOL, 2Z weekly (~31.1M), BTC issuance skipped as continuous emissions
